app-templates.message:
feat(explainer): make exercises, solutions and sections recognisable

## Intent

Exercises did not read as exercises with solutions, and sections were hard to tell apart. Learners should see at a glance where a task starts, where its solution is and where a new section begins, on a phone and on a desktop, with and without JavaScript.

## Key changes

- Every exercise sits in a card with a visible label ("Übung", in English "Exercise"), also without JavaScript.
- The solution is a green, marked box; the hint stays neutral and dashed.
- Each section starts with a rule and more space, and its heading is larger. Subsections get an accent bar.
- The task text of a live exercise wraps inside its frame instead of running over the border.
- Worked tasks are separated from each other.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The review rules and the browser tests do not know the new label yet.
